messages:
sre-oncall: PHX pop p99 jumped ~300ms around 2026-03-18T14:05Z. Not correlated with deploys in the window. Any runtime signals?
maya (runtime): I'm seeing kernel-selector flipflop on a subset of hosts in PHX, plus kv-cache evictions for short sessions. traces attached to bug 4521.
sre-oncall: can you paste the quick perf snapshot? even a 5s sample helps.
maya (runtime): quick snippet from the probe: 
```
perf top -p <pid> -n 20
  12.3%  libc-2.31.so  __memcpy_avx_unaligned
  9.7%   runtime.so    kernel_selector_select_best
  7.2%   runtime.so    kvcache::evict_if_needed
  5.1%   vmlinux       __netif_receive_skb
```
maya (runtime): kernel_selector_select_best is oscillating between avx and fallback kernels depending on seq_len histogram. Batching heuristic bumped in canary earlier this week may amplify.
ben (netops): on the network side: upstream for PHX (ISP-A) did a config push ~14:03Z that changed ECMP preferences; we saw a transient 30-40ms path change for ~2 minutes. Flow logs show reordering to a different edge ASN for ~20% of traffic.
alice (mlperf): KV cache misses spiked in the same window for requests with short prefixes — miss rate went from 4% to 22% on effected hosts. That aligns with maya's eviction note.
devon (infra): I pulled host 10.45.23.12 from LB pool for debug; cpu steal was low but iowait ticked up during the spike. No recent kernel updates.
maya (runtime): hypothesis: ECMP path changes increased RTT/jitter -> more out-of-order arrival -> kernel selector runtime heuristics see higher variance in sequence lengths/latencies -> selects fallback kernel and smaller batch sizes -> causes higher per-token latency and thrashes kv cache due to more small requests.
sre-oncall: timeline sync: network change 14:03, perf spike 14:05, kv miss spike 14:06, selector flip 14:07. makes sense.
ben (netops): rolled back the ECMP tweak at 14:08; route convergence completed by 14:10.
maya (runtime): after rollback we see selector stabilizing and batch size returning. kv miss rate back down to ~6% on hosts that weren't overloaded. p99 returning to baseline.
alice (mlperf): recording this as perf incident PHX-2026-03-18-1. We should add a test that simulates path jitter to the runtime canary, and a regression guard for the batching heuristic.
maya (runtime): agreed. short-term mitigations: 1) pin kernel-selector to previous stable on PHX canary group 2) temporarily increase kvcache size/ttl for short prefixes 3) add a heuristic to avoid switching kernels on <200ms variance windows. I'll open PRs.
sre-oncall: sounds good. assign action items and update incident postmortem. thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy request created by maya — PR #3248 targeting canary with kernel-selector pin. CI checks queued.
